title: Cover
subtitle: 本課限定語境：the outside/front protective part of a book, magazine, booklet, report, or similar
description: 本課限定語境：the outside/front protective part of a book, magazine, booklet, report, or similar item · 「封面／外封／書封」

words.note: 當 cover 明確指書、雜誌、報告最前面的那一面時，這是最直接的說法。
words.example: The author's name appears on the front cover.

exercises.original: The author's name is printed on the cover of the book.
exercises.zh: 作者姓名印在書的正面封面上。
exercises.upgrade: The author's name is printed on the front cover of the book.

options.explanation: 書名／作者名印在書本外面正面，是典型 front cover。
通常位於書內，也可能列作者名，但不是外封。
較常指報紙頭版或文件第一頁。
太泛，沒有指出正面封面。

exercises.original: A large photograph appears on the magazine cover.
exercises.zh: 雜誌正面封面上有一張大型照片。
exercises.upgrade: A large photograph appears on the magazine's front cover.

options.explanation: 雜誌外面正面最自然稱 front cover。
更像文件中的封面頁，不是雜誌外封的標準說法。
通常用於新聞，例如 front-page story，不等於雜誌封面。

exercises.original: The title was redesigned to stand out more clearly on the cover.
exercises.zh: 書名重新設計，使它在封面上更突出。
exercises.upgrade: The title was redesigned to stand out more clearly on the front cover.

options.explanation: 對一般讀者首先看到的正面封面最自然。
書名也可印在書脊，但句子談的是主封面視覺設計。
若是精裝書可能存在 dust jacket，但原句沒有說是可拆書衣。
通常不是主標題視覺中心。
指建築物正面等，不是書封。

words.note: 表示包在最外面的封面或外層。
words.example: The outer cover is made from thick card.

exercises.original: The cover is made from thick card to protect the pages inside.
exercises.zh: 外封由厚卡紙製成，用來保護內頁。
exercises.upgrade: The outer cover is made from thick card.

options.explanation: 重點是最外層實體保護部分。
是紙張頁面，不是厚卡外封。

exercises.original: The booklet's cover was damaged, but the pages inside were unaffected.
exercises.zh: 小冊子的外封損壞了，但內頁沒有受影響。
exercises.upgrade: The booklet's outer cover was damaged.

options.explanation: 和 pages inside 形成外層／內頁對比。
第一頁受損不等於外封受損。
可能受損，但句子明確說 cover。

exercises.original: The designer changed both the front and back of the cover.
exercises.zh: 設計師修改了外封的正面和背面。
exercises.upgrade: The designer changed both sides of the outer cover.

options.explanation: 既包括 front 又包括 back，因此比 front cover 更完整。
文件第一頁，不是整體外封。
只有可拆書衣的書才適用。

words.note: 當 cover 明確屬於一本書時，最自然、最直接。
words.example: The book cover features a photograph of the city.
words.exampleZh: 書封上印有一張城市照片。

exercises.original: The cover of the novel features a photograph of the city.
exercises.zh: 小說書封上有一張城市照片。
exercises.upgrade: The book cover features a photograph of the city.

options.explanation: 最直接指一本書的封面。

exercises.original: Publishers often test several cover designs before releasing a new book.
exercises.zh: 出版社在推出新書前常測試幾款書封設計。
exercises.upgrade: Publishers often test several book cover designs.

options.explanation: book cover design 是標準搭配。
作複合修飾語有時可加連字號，但在此名詞片語中通常寫 book cover designs。
是裝訂，不等於封面視覺。

exercises.original: The illustrator created the cover for the children's book.
exercises.zh: 插畫家為兒童書創作書封。
exercises.upgrade: The illustrator created the book cover.

options.explanation: 插畫家創作封面圖像最自然。
通常是裝訂工藝，不是插畫工作。
表示「有封面的書」，不是封面本身。

words.note: 強調 cover 的作用是保護內部物件。
words.example: The album comes with a protective cover.
words.exampleZh: 這本相簿附有保護外套。

exercises.original: The album comes with a cover that protects it from dust and scratches.
exercises.zh: 相簿附有保護封套，可防塵及防刮。
exercises.upgrade: The album comes with a protective cover.

options.explanation: protects ... from dust and scratches 直接說明功能。
是特定書本紙質書衣，不適合所有相簿。
只是正面，不一定是額外保護層。

exercises.original: Please replace the cover after using the document folder.
exercises.zh: 使用文件夾後，請把保護套重新套上。
exercises.upgrade: Please replace the protective cover after use.

options.explanation: replace ... after using 表示可移除的保護層。
通常不會用後拆下再裝回。

exercises.original: The notebook has a transparent cover to keep the surface clean.
exercises.zh: 筆記簿有透明保護封套，保持表面清潔。
exercises.upgrade: The notebook has a transparent protective cover.

options.explanation: 透明＋保持清潔，功能最明確。
可透明，但句子突出額外保護功能。
若筆記簿整本滑入套中可成立；但一般透明貼合外層更像 protective cover。

words.note: 精裝書外面可拆下來的紙質外套。
words.example: The original dust jacket is still in excellent condition.
words.exampleZh: 原裝書衣仍保存得很好。

exercises.original: The hardcover book still has its original removable cover.
exercises.zh: 這本精裝書仍保留原裝可拆書衣。
exercises.upgrade: The hardcover book still has its original dust jacket.

options.explanation: hardcover + removable cover 是直接定義。
精裝書本身的前封通常不可拆。
可能是套袋式外套，但不是典型 hardcover paper jacket。

exercises.original: Collectors pay more for first editions whose original cover is still wrapped around the hard boards.
exercises.zh: 收藏家會為仍保留原裝書衣的初版書支付更高價格。
exercises.upgrade: Collectors pay more when the original dust jacket is still present.

options.explanation: 收藏語境中的「原裝可拆書衣」非常典型。
太廣；精裝硬板本身也是 book cover。

exercises.original: The publisher printed the summary on the inside flap of the cover.
exercises.zh: 出版社把內容簡介印在書衣內摺頁上。
exercises.upgrade: The publisher printed the summary on the inside flap of the dust jacket.

options.explanation: inside flap 是 dust jacket 的典型結構。
普通 front cover 通常沒有可摺的內 flap。
wrapper 可泛指包封，但不如 dust jacket 精確。

words.note: 在出版語境中可作 dust jacket 的簡稱。
words.example: The first edition still has its original jacket.
words.exampleZh: 這本初版書仍保留原裝書衣。

exercises.original: The rare book is valuable because its original cover is still intact.
exercises.zh: 這本珍本很有價值，因為原裝書衣仍然完好。
exercises.upgrade: The rare book is valuable because its original jacket is still intact.

options.explanation: 在收藏／出版上下文中，jacket 常是 dust jacket 的簡稱。
形容詞，表示有外套包覆。

exercises.original: The cover was removed before the hardcover book was placed on display.
exercises.zh: 精裝書展示前先把書衣取下。
exercises.upgrade: The jacket was removed before the hardcover book was displayed.

options.explanation: 可從 hardcover 上拿下的 cover 很自然叫 jacket。
硬板前封不是正常會取下的部分。
拆除 binding 會破壞書本。
內頁不能像外套般取下。

exercises.original: The artist designed both the book itself and the removable cover around it.
exercises.zh: 藝術家既設計書本本身，也設計外面的可拆書衣。
exercises.upgrade: The artist designed both the book and its jacket.

options.explanation: removable cover around it 明確指書衣。
可泛指外封，但沒有可拆這層資訊。
表示包覆材料／動作，不是此處最自然的可數物件名詞。

words.note: 表示物件滑入其中的外套或套袋。
words.example: The record is stored in a printed sleeve.
words.exampleZh: 唱片存放在印刷封套內。

exercises.original: The record is stored in a printed cover that it slides into.
exercises.zh: 唱片存放在一個可把唱片滑入其中的印刷封套內。
exercises.upgrade: The record is stored in a printed sleeve.

options.explanation: 物件「滑入」外套中的結構正是 sleeve。
可表示套管材料／包套過程，不是最自然的單個外套名詞。

exercises.original: The CD booklet comes inside a protective paper cover.
exercises.zh: CD 小冊子放在紙質封套內。
exercises.upgrade: The CD booklet comes inside a paper sleeve.

options.explanation: inside + paper cover 表示套袋式外層。
可泛指外套，但出版書衣意味較強。

exercises.original: Each card is protected by a clear plastic cover that fits around it.
exercises.zh: 每張卡片都有透明塑膠封套保護。
exercises.upgrade: Each card is protected by a clear plastic sleeve.

options.explanation: 卡片套進透明塑膠套中，是典型 sleeve。
可以包覆，但通常不像透明卡套這樣貼合、套入。
表示「無袖的」，意思完全不同。

words.note: 表示包覆書、雜誌或產品外面的紙質／薄層包裝。
words.example: The booklet was protected by a paper wrapper.
words.exampleZh: 小冊子外面有紙質封皮保護。

exercises.original: The booklet was protected by a paper cover wrapped around the outside.
exercises.zh: 小冊子外面有一層紙質包封保護。
exercises.upgrade: The booklet was protected by a paper wrapper.

options.explanation: wrapped around the outside 直接對應包封外層。
若是精裝書可用，但 booklet 未必有正式書衣。
表示包裝材料／動作，語義較泛。

exercises.original: The collector carefully removed the old cover from around the magazine.
exercises.zh: 收藏家小心取下雜誌外面的舊包封。
exercises.upgrade: The collector carefully removed the old wrapper from around the magazine.

options.explanation: removed ... from around 強調額外包覆層。
雜誌本身正面通常不是額外取下的包裝層。

exercises.original: The special edition came in a decorative outer cover made of printed paper.
exercises.zh: 特別版附有印刷紙製的裝飾性外包封。
exercises.upgrade: The special edition came in a decorative wrapper.

options.explanation: 裝飾性紙外包層最合適。
太廣，可能指書本本身封面。
若是套入式結構才更精確。

words.note: 較廣泛，表示包覆、遮蓋或保護某物的外層材料。
words.example: The leather covering protects the notebook.
words.exampleZh: 皮革外層保護這本筆記簿。

exercises.original: The leather cover protects the notebook from wear.
exercises.zh: 皮革外層保護筆記簿免受磨損。
exercises.upgrade: The leather covering protects the notebook from wear.

options.explanation: 表示整體包覆的外層材料。
裝訂結構，雖可能含皮革但語義不同。

exercises.original: The protective cover on the box is made from waterproof fabric.
exercises.zh: 盒子外面的保護覆層由防水布料製成。
exercises.upgrade: The protective covering on the box is made from waterproof fabric.

options.explanation: 比 book/document cover 更廣，適合一般物件外層。
可作複數名詞，但原句需要單一「外層材料」概念。

exercises.original: The old notebook still has its original cloth cover.
exercises.zh: 舊筆記簿仍保留原裝布質外層。
exercises.upgrade: The old notebook still has its original cloth covering.

options.explanation: 強調 cloth 作為包覆材料。
通常較像紙質額外包封。

falseSynonyms.zh: 首頁／頭版 ≠ 封面 front page 通常指： - 報紙頭版 - 文件第一頁 - 網站首頁（某些語境） 它通常不是書本的實體封面。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The headline appeared on the newspaper's front page. The novel's title appeared on the front cover.

falseSynonyms.zh: 封面頁 ≠ 實體封皮 cover page 通常是報告、作業、傳真等文件最前面的一頁，包含標題、作者、日期等資料。 它可能位於文件最前面，但和實體 cover 不完全相同。
扉頁 ≠ 封面 title page 通常位於書內，列出： 不是外面的 cover。
裝訂 ≠ 封面 binding 是把書頁固定成冊的結構／工藝。 封面可以是 binding 的一部分，但兩者不等義。
書脊 ≠ 整個封面 spine 只是書本側邊連接前後封面的部分。
封底 ≠ 正面封面 如果原句中的 cover 明確指正面，back cover 不能替換。
詞性陷阱 - cover = 名詞／動詞 - covering = 名詞，覆蓋物 - covered = 過去分詞／形容詞，被覆蓋的
結構不同 - jacket = 包在外面的可拆外套 - sleeve = 物件插入其中的套 - cover = 更廣泛的封面／外層
